title: Undead Steve Mod
description: This mod adds a basic undead steve mob that fights the player.
body:
**About:**
A very basic forge mod that adds a new "Undead Steve" mob and a new sword, used by the mob and acquirable by the player. Initially the mod was made to be a part of my modpack, however I decided to share it with the world. The mod has translations to the following languages: **Russian** (by Lewkins18)
**German** (by Panzkrafter)
